vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.2

The persona-customer-support skill bundle is a standard configuration for an AI agent to manage customer support tasks using Google Workspace tools. The instructions in SKILL.md and the requirements in _meta.json are consistent with the stated purpose of triaging emails, updating spreadsheets, and managing calendars, with no evidence of malicious behavior or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (managing support via Gmail, Sheets, Chat, Calendar) aligns with its instructions and requirements; it's an instruction-only persona that delegates work to Google Workspace helper skills and a 'gws' CLI.

dimensions.detail: Name/description map directly to the actions in SKILL.md (triage Gmail, create tasks, append Sheets, post to Chat, schedule Calendar events). The single required binary ('gws') and the listed helper skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) are consistent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are narrowly scoped to using the 'gws' CLI and the listed workflows/commands for support tasks. The instructions do not request reading unrelated files, system config, or undefined environment variables; they instruct only expected operations (triage, convert email to tasks, append to sheet, escalate to chat, insert calendar events).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files, so nothing is written to disk by this skill itself. Lower installation risk as provided.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself requires no env vars or credentials, but it depends on helper 'gws-*' skills and the 'gws' binary that will likely require Google Workspace credentials / OAuth tokens. That is proportionate for the stated purpose, but you should inspect those helper skills and credential scopes before granting access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and model invocation is allowed (platform default). The skill does not request permanent presence or modify other skills' configuration; no elevated privilege is requested here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to Google Workspace support workflows, but it depends on a 'gws' CLI and other gws-* helper skills that will require Google credentials/permissions. Before installing: verify the origin and trustworthiness of the 'gws' binary and the helper skills (their source, repo, or publisher); review and restrict the OAuth scopes you grant (use least-privilege scopes and a test account if possible); confirm where escalations (Chat) will post and that sensitive data won't be forwarded unintentionally; and test actions in a non-production environment first. If you can't verify the 'gws' tool or the helper skill sources, treat them as untrusted.
